entries.title: Hosea 12:1
segments: ¶Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.

entries.title: Hosea 12:2
segments: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him. {punish: Heb. visit upon}

entries.title: Hosea 12:3
segments: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God: {had...: Heb. was a prince, or, behaved himself princely}

words.text: : {had...: Heb. was a prince, or, behaved himself princely}

entries.title: Hosea 12:4
segments: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him [in] Bethel, and there he spake with us;

entries.title: Hosea 12:5
segments: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD [is] his memorial.

entries.title: Hosea 12:6
segments: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.

entries.title: Hosea 12:7
segments: ¶[He is] a merchant, the balances of deceit [are] in his hand: he loveth to oppress. {a merchant: or, Canaan} {oppress: or, deceive}

entries.title: Hosea 12:8
segments: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: [in] all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that [were] sin. {in all...: or, all my labours suffice me not: he shall have punishment of iniquity in whom is sin} {that: Heb. which}

words.text: . {in all...: or, all my labours suffice me not: he shall have punishment of iniquity in whom is sin} {that: Heb. which}

entries.title: Hosea 12:9
segments: And I [that am] the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.

words.text: will yet make thee to dwell

entries.title: Hosea 12:10
segments: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets. {ministry: Heb. hand}

entries.title: Hosea 12:11
segments: [Is there] iniquity [in] Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars [are] as heaps in the furrows of the fields.

entries.title: Hosea 12:12
segments: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept [sheep].

entries.title: Hosea 12:13
segments: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

entries.title: Hosea 12:14
segments: Ephraim provoked [him] to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him. {most...: Heb. with bitternesses} {blood: Heb. bloods}

words.text: unto him. {most...: Heb. with bitternesses} {blood: Heb. bloods}
